headline: Tokyo November Core Inflation Accelerates to 2.9%, Boosting Rate Hike Case
summary: Core consumer prices in Tokyo rose 2.9% year-on-year in November, accelerating to a 16-month high and bolstering the case for a Bank of Japan interest rate hike.
why: Tokyo's core inflation serves as a leading indicator for nationwide price trends in Japan, directly influencing Bank of Japan monetary policy expectations.

impacts.name: USD/JPY
impacts.why: Accelerating inflation increases expectations of a Bank of Japan rate hike, strengthening the yen.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Higher-than-expected core inflation figures reinforced market expectations that the Bank of Japan will proceed with an interest rate hike.
